text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san, happy birthday! Did you get 
that good-luck bracelet for relieving 
fatigue yet?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I got yours and Tarumae-chan's loud and 
clear! Thank you~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to take those haskap throat 
lozenges before your concert! I just hope 
they can be of some help when you sing, 
Falco-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll definitely give it a lick♪ 
...Oh, that's right! I posted the present 
I got on Umastagram, and—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look! All the fans in the comments are 
saying, "I bought one too~♪"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't this our chance? While 
everyone's interested, why not promote 
both Feng Shui and Tomakomai even more~?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're so right...! Falco-san, I really 
want to introduce Tomakomai's "Yoitomake"!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no fair, me too! How about some 
incense that boosts your luck!? It's super 
effective, so you've definitely gotta try 
it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep♪ In that case, you two are 
officially guest stars at Falco's birthday 
live! Make sure to spread the word lots 
during the free talk segment, okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please spread the word on your socials 
too, everyone♪ Let's make this a great 
concert! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, is that what we were talking 
about?!
